headline: Novo Nordisk Sues Eli Lilly Over Alleged Deceptive Weight Loss Drug Advertising
summary: Novo Nordisk has filed a lawsuit against Eli Lilly, alleging false advertising and deceptive marketing for Zepbound and Mounjaro treatments.

headline: Eli Lilly On Novo Nordisk Lawsuit, Says "We Stand Firmly Behind Our Advertising"; We Will Continue To Focus On The Science And Defend Against Novo Nordisk Lawsuit Vigorously; Rather Than Compete On The Merits Of Its Products, Novo Is Asking Court To Stop Lilly From Communicating Results Of That Trial
